note: Meson option sets for build-dxvk.ps1, the only copy it reads. Options are compared with the new meson log's 'Build Options:' line after configure; targets are the ninja targets built and hashed; 'ships' names, per target, the file names the release ships it as, and the build writes one copy per name next to the target and stamps each with its own version resource (BD-166, tools/build/versionstamp.py). A target no release ships has no entry.

msvc.description: cl.exe, link.exe and lib.exe of the Visual Studio developer environment: the compiler of every engine up to tester.31v3

clang-cl.description: clang-cl.exe, lld-link.exe and llvm-lib.exe of an LLVM Windows toolchain (build-dxvk.ps1 -ClangToolchain, default LLVM 23.1.4), in the same Visual Studio environment for headers, libraries and rc.exe. /clang:-ffp-contract=off: a multiply and an add round separately, as with MSVC, whose /fp:precise does not contract them. The PDB keeps full CodeView types (DXVK's /Z7); the ThinLTO type-record fault that made the Mesa recipe drop them needs LTO, which no DXVK set uses. -Dssize_t=intptr_t: libdisplay-info defines ssize_t so only when the compiler id is msvc, and clang-cl's id is clang-cl; the C sources of the build are libdisplay-info's and one of src/util, which does not use the name

per-app.description: Upstream DXVK as application-local d3d11/dxgi/d3d10core/d3d9 DLLs: the per-application comparison path of the M14 5 % bound (D004) and the M12 E33 packages

ddi-engine.description: amdgpu_wddm_dxvk.dll, DXVK's D3D10/11 implementation as the engine behind the M14 system D3D10/11 DDI UMD (ADR 0017 item 4); needs the amdgpu-wddm/ddi-engine DXVK branch
